title: Recording cut list
description: A Recording's Segments, stored beside the source at recordings/<recording-id>/cuts.json. See docs/format-spec.md.

hash.description: Content hash of source.gif; detects a swapped source.

frameCount.description: Frame count of source.gif; detects a truncated/replaced file.

id.description: Cut id; unique within this Recording.

endFrame.description: Exclusive; the range is half-open [startFrame, endFrame).

speed.description: Playback multiplier applied when generating a Clip; does not change the range. Omitted when 1.
